declarations.name: HueHop
declarations.description: Colors each letter of its text with a different step of a color ramp.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: The color of the first letter, which sets `--hop-start` on this element. Left out, it comes from `hue` if one is set. Otherwise it's picked from the end color.

attributes.name: end
attributes.description: The color of the last letter, which sets `--hop-end` on this element. Left out, it comes from `hue` if one is set. Otherwise it's picked from the start color.

attributes.name: curve
attributes.description: How the steps are spaced, which sets `--hop-curve` on this element. `1` is even, higher stays near the start color longer, and lower reaches the end color sooner.

attributes.name: boost
attributes.description: How much extra color intensity the middle letters get, which sets `--hop-boost` on this element and beats a hue's own boost.

attributes.name: shift
attributes.description: Turns each letter's hue by this many degrees, which sets `--hop-shift` on this element. Write a plain number (`30`, not `30deg`).

attributes.name: drift-range
attributes.description: How many degrees the hues sway each way, which sets `--hop-drift-range` on this element. Does nothing without `drift`.

attributes.name: drift-cycle
attributes.description: How long one full sway there and back takes, like `4s`, which sets `--hop-drift-cycle` on this element. Does nothing without `drift`.

attributes.name: drift
attributes.description: Slowly sways the hues back and forth, needs `drift.css`, and holds still when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.description: Picks one of the seven ready-made color pairs.

attributes.name: display
attributes.description: Switches the picked hue to its large-heading version, which passes 3:1 instead of 4.5:1.

members.name: hops
members.description: How many color steps the letters use, one per letter up to 64, or `0` when the element is off the page or the browser lacks support.

members.name: start
members.description: The color of the first letter, mirroring the `start` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: end
members.description: The color of the last letter, mirroring the `end` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: curve
members.description: How the steps are spaced, mirroring the `curve` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: boost
members.description: How much extra color intensity the middle letters get, mirroring the `boost` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: shift
members.description: How many degrees each letter's hue turns, mirroring the `shift` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: driftRange
members.description: How many degrees the hues sway each way, mirroring the `drift-range` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: driftCycle
members.description: How long one full sway takes, mirroring the `drift-cycle` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: hue
members.description: Which ready-made color pair the element uses, mirroring the `hue` attribute, where `null` removes it.

members.name: display
members.description: Whether the hue uses its large-heading version, mirroring the `display` attribute, where `false` removes it.

members.name: drift
members.description: Whether the hues sway, mirroring the `drift` attribute, where `false` removes it.

cssProperties.name: --hop-start
cssProperties.description: The color of the first letter. Left out, it's picked from `--hop-end`.

cssProperties.name: --hop-end
cssProperties.description: The color of the last letter. Left out, it's picked from `--hop-start`.

cssProperties.name: --hop-curve
cssProperties.description: How the steps are spaced: `1` is even, higher stays near the start color longer, and lower reaches the end color sooner.

cssProperties.name: --hop-boost
cssProperties.description: How much extra color intensity (OKLCH chroma) the middle letters get, so the blend doesn't go dull halfway. A hue's boost is a default, and any `--hop-boost` beats it, inherited or not.

cssProperties.name: --hop-shift
cssProperties.description: Turns each letter's hue by this many degrees, written as a plain number (`30`, not `30deg`).

cssProperties.name: --hop-drift-range
cssProperties.description: How many degrees the hues sway each way when `drift` is on, written as a plain number.

cssProperties.name: --hop-drift-cycle
cssProperties.description: How long one full sway there and back takes when `drift` is on.
